articles.title: 22-Year Wait Ends: Arsenal's Premier League Victory Parade Paints London Red
articles.summary: An estimated 500,000 Arsenal supporters flooded Islington for a victory parade celebrating the club's first Premier League title since the 2004 'Invincibles' season. The women's team also showcased the inaugural Fifa Women's Champions Cup. The celebration followed a heartbreaking Champions League final loss the day before.

articles.title: Sunscreen Decoded: Why SPF 30, 50, and 100 Aren't as Different as You Think
articles.summary: Dermatologists reveal that SPF 30 blocks 97% of UVB rays, SPF 50 blocks 98%, and higher numbers offer diminishing returns. Most people under-apply, so a higher SPF provides a margin of error. No sunscreen blocks 100% of rays.

articles.title: Ethiopia's Pivotal Election: Youthful Electorate, 47 Parties, and a Prime Minister at Stake
articles.summary: Ethiopians head to the polls Monday in a general election with over 50 million registered voters and 47 parties vying for parliament. The median age is 19, giving young voters enormous sway. The next prime minister will be chosen by the winning coalition.
